reviewNotice: This is an in-progress paper kit with a theorem-level semantic mismatch. Concrete proofs cover the dyadic foundations, selected Section 4 results, full Theorem 6.1, all clauses of Lemmas 6.4-6.7, clauses (i),(ii),(iii),(v),(vi) of Lemma 6.8 plus n>=4 of (iv), and full Lemma 6.12. The n=2 instance printed in Lemma 6.8(iv) is formally refuted by an independently audited, nonvacuous actual 2-ADC counterexample through fe2a459; reports 26-31 give the scope. Lemma 6.12 is source-first audited through cf9f83b and proves that the actual exceptional lattice in W_1^4(Delta) is 2-ADC, not 3-ADC, and nonmaximal; report 32 gives the scope. The printed V-domain wrappers expose the compatible Delta-in-U convention. Clean-kit CI at f6f7485/c82668b includes full Lemma 6.7 and the enforcing gate, but not the later Lemma 6.8, discrepancy, or Lemma 6.12 additions. Global arithmetic premises, Theorem 6.2, Lemmas 6.9-6.11, the other local ADC classifications and enumeration remain incomplete. Exact-revision clean CI, release promotion, and human sign-off remain separate gates.
